items.title: SMU-Florida State Kicked Off With Only Some Lights, No Replay After Power Outage
items.summary: The start of the game between No. 19 SMU and Florida State on Monday night was delayed to a power outage at the stadium just minutes before the scheduled kickoff.

items.title: Chapman shifts to casual New Zealand contract to play in the BBL
items.summary: Chapman set to play in the white-ball series against India in November before heading to the BBL with seamer Matt Fisher elevated to the full-time contract list
